name: Hahnenkamm Reutte
kurzbeschreibung: The Hahnenkamm mountain near Reutte features a modern cable car, barrier-free alpine flower garden, and 360-degree views over the Außerfern region.
preis: Hiking trails freely accessible; cable car ride fee applies (approx. €26 for adults)
oeffnungszeiten: Open daily mid-May to late October and December to early April
beschreibung:
Overview

The distinctive and beloved Hahnenkamm near Reutte rises to an altitude of 1,938 meters above the broad basin of the Tyrolean Außerfern, serving as the signature local mountain for Reutte and Höfen. Forming the eastern bastion of the Tannheimer Mountains, this gently curved panoramic summit commands a sensational 360-degree outlook stretching from the Lechtal valley and the Zugspitze to the Allgäu Alps and the Bavarian Alpine foothills. Served by the modern Reuttener Seilbahn cable car, the Bergwelt Hahnenkamm has evolved into a premier year-round recreational haven for hikers, nature lovers, families, and paragliders. Sunny south-facing slopes boast rich alpine flora including protected gentians, carline thistles, and alpine roses, while winter blankets the slopes with reliable snow for skiing.

Route & Requirements

The ascent aboard the modern 8-seater gondola from Höfen to the mountain station at 1,730 meters takes less than ten minutes and is completely barrier-free. Directly adjacent to the station lies the lovingly curated Alpine Flower Garden, a firm, stroller- and wheelchair-friendly loop showcasing over six hundred high-altitude plant species with informative plaques. From the top station, a well-marked mountain path ascends in roughly forty-five minutes to the Hahnenkamm summit cross at 1,938 meters (difficulty T2, 210 meters vertical rise). Experienced hikers can continue along the exposed ridge path to the Gaichtspitze or descend via the rustic Schneetalalm hut. Sturdy hiking boots with grippy soles and windproof clothing are recommended; trekking poles ease the descent on knee joints.

Visit & Arrival

The Reuttener Seilbahn operates daily from mid-May to late October in summer and from December to early April in winter. The valley station in Höfen features ample free parking and is easily accessed via the B179 Fernpass road and the Reutte bypass in just a few minutes. Train passengers travel on the Außerfernbahn to Reutte in Tirol station and board regional bus 100 directly to Höfen Hahnenkammbahn.

Tips

Unwind after your hike at the Panorama Restaurant beside the top station, enjoying fresh Kaiserschmarrn on the sun terrace while watching paragliders launch smoothly into the valley. In clear weather, peer through the mounted telescope towards the distant Zugspitze.
